title: Cost-Efficient Subjective Task Annotation and Modeling through Few-Shot Annotator Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the standard deviation of the F1 score across individual annotators to quantify performance disparity and ensure equitable model performance for all diverse annotator perspectives.

Comparing and visualizing annotator-level F1 scores between a target group of annotators (Muslim immigrants in the UK) and a control group (Western researchers) on a hate speech dataset to evaluate whether minority perspectives are fairly represented without performance degradation.
